---
pagetitle: "Data Science, Time Series & ML Notebooks"
description: "Step-by-step learning tracks built from runnable Python notebooks on time series, statistics and machine learning."
toc: false
page-layout: custom
title-block-banner: false
html-math-method: plain  # no math on the homepage; skips loading MathJax/KaTeX
listing:
  # Learning roadmap: one listing per track, in recommended reading order.
  # To add a track, copy this block, change id/contents/template-params, and add a matching
  # `::: {#track-<name>}` div in the "Learning roadmap" section below.
  - id: track-time-series
    contents: "time-series/*.ipynb"
    sort: "order asc"
    template: _templates/track-card.ejs
    template-params:
      number: "01"
      name: "Time Series"
      description: "Decompose, test and forecast time series in Python, from STL and stationarity tests to ARIMA and SARIMA."
      href: "time-series/"
  # Latest articles across all tracks (also generates the RSS feed at index.xml)
  - id: latest
    contents: "*/*.ipynb"
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 5
    template: _templates/post-row.ejs
    feed: true
---
